title: H0 diagnostic session on ibm_fez: the DD x twirling factorial of the frozen canary circuit and the windowed idle tests that decide between the idle-relaxation and the sampler-options hypotheses

criteria.name: C1 every job DONE with usage recorded, each <= 30 s, total <= 40 s (4 job directory/ies: J1 5.0 s, J2 4.0 s, J3 3.0 s, J4 3.0 s)
C2 decoder round trip over the accepted strings of 4 canary pub(s) (68 distinct strings)
C3 decisive J1 count: N1 = 35 of 2000 against the preregistered 31 (H_A) and 374 (H_B) -- H_B rejected (the options are not the cause; the idle term is)
C4a t1w (J1): per-qubit decay rate 1/T1_measured within [0.5, 2.0] x 1/T1_record
C5 J1: the idle-aware post-diction with the measured T1/T2 predicts a clean yield 0.00009 against the measured 0.00822
C5 J2: the idle-aware post-diction with the measured T1/T2 predicts a clean yield 0.00035 against the measured 0.00422
C6 readout confusion of patch 1 at 2000 shots (J1): smallest diagonal element
